0.text: Solar demand sets the silver price floor, driving demand higher than ever.

1.text: Silver price moves on five forces: industrial demand (especially solar panels)
investor flows into ETFs and coins, the USA dollar's strength, the gold-silver ratio
The dollar and interest rates push both sides around day to day.
At Fused Distribution, we watch these inputs every morning before we quote.

2.text: So when solar installs grow 20 percent year over year, silver demand grows with it.
That puts a floor under spot price even when investors lose interest.

3.text: When inventory gets thin, lease rates spike and spot price follows.
Global silver mine production is forecast to rise to a seven-year high in 2025 .
But "seven-year high" still leaves output below the 2016 peak
and demand keeps climbing faster than mines can scale.

4.text: Every billion that flows into SLV pulls physical silver off the market and into a vault.

5.text: When the ratio gets above 90, silver is cheap relative to gold.
When it drops below 50, gold is cheap relative to silver.
How to trade it without trading paper: Ratio above 85: shift your next purchase toward silver.
We see buyers load up on silver rounds and 100 oz bars at these levels.

6.text: When all three flash bullish, do not chase.
Wait for a 5-7 percent pullback before adding to your stack.
Domestic mining affects what you pay over spot, not just spot itself.
Geological Survey reported USA silver mine production of approximately 1,000 metric tons in 2024 .
